item.title: Version 2.26.0
item.description:
Three new daily games 🎉

The biggest games drop yet — three brand-new dailies join the family:

  • Enigma — guess the secret famous person. Flip yes/no question tiles, spend them wisely, and name them in three tries. Includes a training mode to learn the ropes.
  • Eras — put five historical events in order on the timeline. The first check is free; every extra one costs you.
  • Rebus — three emoji riddles a day: a saying, a film and a song. Decode them in sequence, buy hints if you get stuck.

Same daily rhythm as always: one challenge per day, shared with everyone, rankings with your friends. Have fun — and tell us what you think from the feedback menu!
